exposure: hemolysis, elevated liver enzymes, and a low platelets (HELLP) syndrome
cohort: 112 pregnant women with liver diseases unique to pregnancy between April 2015 and March 2017
finding: Pregnancy-related liver diseases, particularly pre-eclampsia and HG, are significant contributors to fetal mortality and morbidity, with maternal age and gestational weeks at presentation playing a role in predicting outcomes.
mod_finding: This study on liver diseases in pregnancy included mode of delivery as a data point but did not examine its relationship to any specific outcomes.
gest_age: Varied, mentioned as a significant factor
